attributes.powers:
You may attempt a Combat 20 check to acquire this card instead of the listed check; if you fail, Ayruzi deals damage as if she were a monster.

Discard this card to add 1 die to any check, or to add 2 dice to a Divine check.

Discard this card to reduce all damage dealt to you by 4.

Discard this card to explore your location.
